key_insight: RECAST learns to build the right evidence by routing between retrieval and computation, instead of relying only on similarity-based retrieval.
engineering_relevance: This makes long-context AI more reliable for real-world workflows where answers must be computed, filtered, or aggregated across heterogeneous sources.
method: RouterLM sequentially selects primitive or custom operations.
CompilerLM translates custom operations into executable code.
AnswerLM uses the accepted evidence to generate the final response.
evidence_signal: Across six benchmark families, RECAST reached a 75.6% mean success rate, beating the strongest large-model baseline by 15.9% and improving by 15.0% on three held-out benchmarks.
watch_item: The approach depends on correct routing and safe code execution, so errors in operation selection or compilation could still limit reliability.
paper_title: RECAST: Learning to Compute the Right Context through Adaptive Evidence Routing
